# Vendored third-party JS

- **lottie.min.js** — [lottie-web](https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web) v5.12.2 (`lottie_light.min.js` build — SVG renderer only, no expressions plugin, smaller than the full build), MIT licensed. Vendored (not CDN-linked) so it works fully offline like the rest of this framework.
